cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

mechanism: A leads a wedding trip by adapting to a chain in which the key, tea and invitation become one damaged bundle, forcing a call for directions instead of departure.
confusable: A random string of mishaps lacks each early object returning altered and combining to force the same final action.
comparison: The seating alternative concentrates returning details into an unavoidable serving/seat consequence rather than navigation.
seedUse: Key/cup/invitation seed supplies the chain but its literal lock metaphor is replaced with a legible lost-address problem.
